title: Dynamic Device Targeting in Intune — Dynamic Groups & Filters
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (dynamic security groups + assignment filters for scalable policy/app targeting in Intune; membership-rule logic, precedence).
hook: Target the right devices automatically — with dynamic groups and assignment filters, not manual lists
problem: As a fleet grows, assigning policies and apps to hand-built static groups doesn't scale: new devices miss policy, membership drifts, and admins burn hours maintaining lists. The modern answer is dynamic targeting — dynamic security groups whose membership rules auto-include the right devices, and assignment filters that scope a single assignment to exactly the devices that match (OS, ownership, model, enrollment profile). This solution gives you a repeatable dynamic device targeting model in Intune so policies and apps reach the right devices automatically and stay correct as the fleet changes.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — dynamic security groups (membership rule syntax) vs. assignment filters (rule syntax + include/exclude at assignment time), when to use each, precedence and evaluation, and the scalable targeting model.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID with dynamic-group licensing, a device attribute/naming convention, enrollment profile names, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define the targeting taxonomy, build dynamic security groups with membership rules, create assignment filters, apply filters to policy/app assignments, validate membership and effective targeting, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — dynamic-group/filter discovery, membership and effective-targeting validation, a targeting-coverage and drift report, safe remediation of mis-scoped assignments, and a dynamic-group/filter builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable dynamic device targeting model in Intune — dynamic security groups and assignment filters so policies and apps reach exactly the right devices automatically and stay correct as the fleet changes. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
